answer_1.quote: We propose Grounded Minimal Editor (GME), a pipeline model for grounded minimal editing.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we run each experiment with five random seeds. ... We report BLEU and F1 computed with the human references. For persona consistency, we report the P-Score ... To evaluate fluency, we report the word-level NLL evaluated by GPT-2.

answer_3.quote: To evaluate fluency, we report the word-level NLL evaluated by GPT-2.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 150 test samples for human evaluation. ... We instruct annotators vote prefer A, none, or prefer B. ... For each response, we instruct the participants to answer four questions: • Knowledge (0 or 1) ... • Empathy (0 or 1) ... • Background occurrences ... • Grammaticality (0 or 1).
answer_4.guideline: Participants vote based on minimal editing and persona consistency; criteria include knowledge, empathy, persona consistency, and grammaticality.
